text:
sam: seeing 95p latency jump on eu-west2 small-genpar starting ~01:07 UTC. topology shows dedicated slice warmers kicking off at same time. anyone oncall? :eyes:

rosa: i'm watching. 95p moved from ~140ms -> ~480ms. rack-egress for rack-3 is pegged. seems correlated to warmup batch window.

deepa: is this the slice with 'egress_burst' enabled from the fractional-slices experiment?

sam: yep. config snippet: `slices.fractional.eu-west2.warmup.egress_burst = true`

nick: quick grep from nat gateway logs shows many new connections from warmup workers hitting the same NAT IP. NAT queue depth spiked. snippet:
```
[01:06:52] natgw-3: conn_open src=10.3.4.12:34567 dst=1.2.3.4:443
[01:07:01] natgw-3: queue_depth=42
[01:07:05] natgw-3: queue_depth=128
[01:07:10] natgw-3: dropped=9
```

rosa: that explains proxy tail. NAT saturation introduces packet queuing and retries. we can either throttle warmup egress or route warmup through a different NAT pool.

deepa: short term: can we flip the slice to `egress_burst=false`? prefer allocator-level guard though.

sam: i can flip now if someone approves impact. warmup throughput will slow, preemptible start times up.

nick: approve. do it and note the change in the incident channel.

sam: done: `PATCH /allocator/slices/eu-west2-fractional/warmup {"egress_burst":false}` returned 200. watching metrics.

metricsbot: alert: natgw-3 queue_depth reduced 128 -> 28 within 45s. small-genpar 95p reduced to ~160ms. incident recorded INF-2026-114.

rosa: good. follow-up: we need a deterministic precondition for allocator allowing burst. proposal: require per-rack NAT headroom > 30% and per-tenant egress_credit_balance > X before enabling.

deepa: suggest algorithm: give each slice a starting egress credit of 100 units. each large warmup request consumes one credit per second of sustained open connections. credits replenish at 5 units/sec up to cap. if credits < 20% cap => disable burst.

nick: interesting. credit model avoids single-tenant stomping. plus combine with KV-warmth heuristic: only raise credits if kvcache_hit_rate > 70% for the tenant.

sam: low-effort implementation: allocator dry-run mode first. simulate credit accounting for 24h of traffic and produce a dashboard. if numbers look sane flip to enforced.

rosa: also add a labeling mechanism so that warmup traffic can be routed via `egress_route=warmup` and we can map that to a separate NAT pool in the future. low risk and gives path for infra to split.

deepa: i'll add a small feature branch: allocator/egress_credits + `--dry-run` flag. aim to land prototype by EOD.

nick: add a metric `allocator.egress_credits.rejected_backfills` and an alert when > 5/min. ops can triage when warmup backlog grows.

metricsbot: note: created ticket ALLOC-789 (egress credits prototype) and spawned job to collect 24h sim data.

sam: thanks all. long term infra ask: consider a separate egress path for warmup or an autoscaled NAT fleet for high warmup churn. but that's planning work. for now, credit taper + precondition + label should mitigate.

rosa: adding a short runbook entry: how to toggle `egress_burst` and how to route warmup traffic label. will post link. :thumbsup:

deepa: PR: https://git.internal/allocator/pulls/421 - dry-run egress credits.

nick: closing temp mitigation. reopen if latency climbs back.
